title: Hedge reduction for a Sidney condo

seo.title: Sample project: Sidney condo hedge reduction
seo.description: Sample case study: an overgrown Sidney condo hedge reduced in two stages a year apart, after a check of the Town's tree rules.

summary: An overgrown boundary hedge reduced in stages over two seasons.
plantPalette: Laurel and western redcedar hedge, kept as a screen
challenge: A boundary hedge at a Sidney condo had grown over the sidewalk and shaded the ground-floor units.
approach: We checked the Town's Tree Preservation Bylaw first, because western redcedar is among the species it lists.
The hedge was reduced in two stages a year apart so it would green up again instead of leaving bare stems. Neighbours got notice before each visit.
result: Sidewalk cleared and the hedge kept as a screen.
